# stratcols

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/MindTheGap-ERC/stratcols/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MindTheGap-ERC/stratcols/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)

Handling stratigraphic columns and quantifying stratigraphic order in R.

## Authors

**Niklas Hohmann**  
Utrecht University  
email: n.hohmann \[at\] uu.nl  
Web page: [uu.nl/staff/NHohmann](https://www.uu.nl/staff/NHHohmann)  
Orcid: [0000-0003-1559-1838](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1559-1838)

## Installation

First, install the `remotes` package using

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
```

Then, run

``` r

remotes::install_github(repo = "MindTheGap-ERC/stratcols",
                        ref = "HEAD",
                        dependencies = TRUE,
                        build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

After installation, you can load the package using

    library(stratcols)

Start by reading the vignette, available via

``` r

vignette("stratcols")
```

## References

The methods are described in detail in

- Peter M. Burgess; Identifying Ordered Strata: Evidence, Methods, and
  Meaning. Journal of Sedimentary Research 2016;; 86 (3): 148–167. doi:
  [10.2110/jsr.2016.10](https://doi.org/10.2110/jsr.2016.10)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as_stratcol()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/as_stratcol.md)
  : define stratigraphic column
- [`bed_thickness()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/bed_thickness.md)
  : extract bed thicknesses
- [`facies_names()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/facies_names.md)
  : extract facies names from stratigraphic column
- [`facies_repetitions()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/facies_repetitions.md)
  : have successive beds identical facies?
- [`get_L_unit()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/get_L_unit.md)
  : extract length unit from stratigraphic columns
- [`get_base()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/get_base.md)
  : find base of stratigraphic column
- [`get_mom()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/get_mom.md)
  : Markov order metric (Burgess 2016)
- [`get_rom()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/get_rom.md)
  : runs order metric (Burgess 2016)
- [`is_stratcol()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/is_stratcol.md)
  : is a valid stratigraphic column?
- [`merge_beds()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/merge_beds.md)
  : merge beds in stratigraphic column
- [`no_beds()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/no_beds.md)
  : number of beds
- [`no_facies()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/no_facies.md)
  : number of distinct facies
- [`order_facies_names()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/order_facies_names.md)
  : order facies names according to appearance
- [`plot(`*`<stratcol>`*`)`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/plot.stratcol.md)
  : basic plotting of stratigraphic columns
- [`print(`*`<stratcol>`*`)`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/print.stratcol.md)
  : print stratigraphic column to console
- [`rename_facies()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/rename_facies.md)
  : rename facies
- [`set_L_unit()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/set_L_unit.md)
  : set length unit of strat column
- [`shuffle_col()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/shuffle_col.md)
  : rearrange stratigraphic column
- [`summary(`*`<stratcol>`*`)`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/summary.stratcol.md)
  : summarize stratigraphic column
- [`total_thickness()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/total_thickness.md)
  : get total thickness
- [`total_thickness(`*`<stratcol>`*`)`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/total_thickness.stratcol.md)
  : get total thickness of stratigraphic column
- [`trans_count_matrix()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/trans_count_matrix.md)
  : facies transition count matrix
- [`transition_matrix()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/transition_matrix.md)
  : transition frequency matrix from strat. column
- [`unique_facies_names()`](https://mindthegap-erc.github.io/stratcols/reference/unique_facies_names.md)
  : return unique facies names from a stratigraphic column
